title: SpyreTestConfig
description: Configuration schema for the Spyre PyTorch test framework. Enables OOT device backends to reuse upstream PyTorch tests with fine-grained control over which tests run, how failures are treated, and which ops and dtypes are exercised. Reference implementation: IBM Spyre.

files.description: One entry per upstream PyTorch test file to run on this device.

rel_path.description: Path to the upstream test file. Use ${PYTORCH} (resolves via SPYRE_PYTORCH_ROOT) or ${TORCH_SPYRE} (resolves via SPYRE_TORCH_SPYRE_ROOT) tokens.

unlisted_test_mode.description: Mode applied to tests NOT listed under 'tests', or listed without an explicit 'mode'. Default: xfail.

tests.description: Explicit configuration for specific upstream test methods. Tests not listed here are governed by unlisted_test_mode.

global.description: Device-wide capability declaration. All file and test entries operate within these bounds.

supported_dtypes.description: Positive list of dtypes the device hardware supports. Acts as a hard ceiling — no test variant will run with a dtype outside this list. If omitted, no dtype filtering is applied.

supported_ops.description: Ops the device supports. Only ops listed here generate test variants via _SpyreOpListPatcher. Accepts plain op name strings or structured dicts with per-op overrides. Both formats can be mixed.

oneOf.description: Plain format: op name only, no per-op overrides.

UnlistedTestMode.description: Controls behaviour for tests not explicitly listed or listed without a mode. block=skip entirely. xfail=run, expected to fail (default). xfail_strict=run, must fail. mandatory_success=must pass.

TestMode.description: How to treat variants of this specific test. Applied at variant level — each (test, op, dtype) combination is treated independently. If absent, unlisted_test_mode governs.

NamedItem.description: A named item in an include/exclude list. Dict form for future extensibility (e.g. adding per-item precision overrides).

name.description: Name of the op or dtype.

OpsEdits.description: Per-test op list overrides. Controls which ops are included in @ops.op_list for this specific test.

include.description: Inject ops into @ops.op_list for this test. Only needed when the upstream test uses a pre-filtered op list (e.g. binary_ufuncs_with_references) that excludes an op you want to test.

exclude.description: Remove ops from @ops.op_list for this test only. Use when an op is in supported_ops but you want to suppress it for this specific test.

DtypesEdits.description: Per-test dtype overrides. Controls which dtype variants are generated for this test.

include.description: Inject dtypes into @ops.allowed_dtypes for this test. Without this, dtype variants missing from upstream @ops(allowed_dtypes=(...)) are never generated. Must be a subset of global.supported_dtypes.

exclude.description: Suppress dtype variants for this test only. Useful when a specific (test, dtype) combination is known to crash or produce incorrect results.

DtypeNamedItem.description: A named dtype item. Dict form for future extensibility.

TestEdits.description: Per-test overrides for ops and dtypes. Scoped to this test only — does not affect other tests.

TestEntry.description: Configuration for a specific upstream test method.

mode.description: How to treat variants of this test. If absent, unlisted_test_mode governs.

items.description: Must be a valid Python identifier — used as a pytest mark name.

tags.description: Pytest marks applied to all variants of this test. Enables selection via -m model_name. Example: pytest test_binary_ufuncs.py -m my_model

Precision.description: Numeric tolerance overrides for a specific (op, dtype) combination.

SupportedOpDtypeConfig.description: Per-dtype configuration within a supported op entry. Allows specifying precision per (op, dtype) combination.

name.description: Dtype name. Must be a subset of global.supported_dtypes.

precision.description: Tolerance override for this (op, dtype) combination. Applied to all test variants for this op and dtype.

SupportedOpConfig.description: Structured op entry with optional per-op overrides. Maps back to upstream OpInfo fields.

name.description: Op name matching OpInfo.name in upstream op_db.

force_xfail.description: If true, flips any mandatory_success variant for this op to xfail at the variant level. Has no effect on variants already marked xfail or xfail_strict. Use when an op is in supported_ops but not yet stable enough to require passing.

dtypes.description: Per-dtype configuration for this op. Narrows dtype variants generated by @ops upfront. Each entry can optionally specify precision overrides for that (op, dtype) combination. Must be a subset of global.supported_dtypes.
